title: Career Roadmap · Two-Wheeler Mechanic
summary: A Two-Wheeler Mechanic services, diagnoses and repairs motorcycles, scooters and related systems, including engines, brakes, suspension, electrical components and electronic controls.

blocks.text: Primary pathway

items: ITI Mechanic Two & Three Wheeler / relevant automotive trade

blocks.text: Core work
Periodic servicing • Engine repair • Brakes and suspension • Battery and electrical systems • Fault diagnosis • Preventive maintenance.

blocks.label: Recommended
blocks.text: Class 10; verify the current trade-specific entry qualification.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Science and Mathematics are useful but may not be mandatory for every relevant vocational trade.

blocks.label: Admission
blocks.text: State ITI counselling or institute-specific admission.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Motorcycle engines, scooter transmission systems, vehicle electronics, electric two-wheelers and workshop safety.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Mechanical reasoning, measurement, troubleshooting and safe tool handling.

rows.text: ITI Mechanic Electric Vehicle, where available
Advanced diagnostics, service operations and technical roles

items: Diploma in Automobile or Mechanical Engineering
Service technician, diagnostic technician or workshop roles, subject to eligibility

blocks.text: Government / Public — 5 options to investigate

items.text: Government ITIs in Andhra Pradesh — check Mechanic Two & Three Wheeler.
Government ITIs in Telangana — verify automotive trade availability.
Government ITIs in Tamil Nadu — check current admissions.
Government ITIs in Karnataka — verify relevant trades.
National Skill Training Institutes (NSTIs) — investigate automotive technical training.

blocks.text: Private / other recognized options

items.text: NCVT-affiliated private ITIs offering Mechanic Two & Three Wheeler.
Motorcycle and scooter manufacturer service-training programs.
Dealerships and service networks offering apprenticeships.

blocks.text: DGT lists Mechanic Two & Three Wheeler as a one-year, 1,200-hour CTS trade, with Class 10 Science and Mathematics or an accepted equivalent as the entry qualification. Verify current availability via DGT and NCVT MIS.

Category-based scholarships, subject to scheme rules.

blocks.text: Check the National Scholarship Portal and state scholarship portals. Eligibility varies by income, category, domicile and course. Verify current official notification.

blocks.label: Stage 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Workshop safety, hand tools, measurement, vehicle components and basic electrical principles.

blocks.label: Stage 2 — Core skills
blocks.text: Engine servicing, oil changes, brakes, suspension, transmission and battery maintenance.

blocks.label: Stage 3 — Advanced skills
blocks.text: Fuel injection, electronic diagnostics, sensors, charging systems and EV safety fundamentals.

blocks.label: Stage 4 — Career preparation
blocks.text: Supervised servicing, repair records, diagnostic practice and apprenticeship applications.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Prepare a periodic-service checklist • Inspect a brake assembly • Diagnose a fault on a training engine • Test a battery and charging system using approved procedures.

blocks.label: Government / public sector
blocks.text: Transport workshops, railway workshops and eligible public-sector maintenance facilities.

blocks.label: Private sector
blocks.text: Motorcycle and scooter dealerships, authorised service centres, independent garages, fleet operators and EV service networks.

blocks.label: Ideal training areas
blocks.text: Periodic servicing • Engine repair • Vehicle electrical systems • Brake and suspension maintenance.
Search Apprenticeship India and manufacturer career pages. Openings, eligibility and stipend depend on the employer.

blocks.label: Diagnostics route
blocks.text: Workshop experience + diagnostic training → Vehicle Diagnostic Technician.

blocks.label: EV route
blocks.text: Relevant EV training and safety instruction → Electric Two-Wheeler Service Technician.

blocks.label: Self-employment route
blocks.text: Practical experience → Independent two-wheeler repair shop.

blocks.label: Further education
blocks.text: Eligible diploma in Automobile or Mechanical Engineering → broader service, technical-support or workshop-management roles.
Relevant programs

blocks.label: Specializations
blocks.text: Engine overhaul • Fuel systems • Vehicle electronics • Scooter transmission • Electric two-wheelers • Workshop operations.

items.text: EV Service Technician, with suitable training
Service Advisor, with additional customer-service skills

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Dealerships, independent garages, automotive service chains, fleet maintenance, vehicle manufacturers and EV service companies.

blocks.label: Technical skills
blocks.text: Servicing, engine repair, troubleshooting, electrical testing, brake maintenance, component inspection and repair documentation.

blocks.label: Tools / technologies
blocks.text: Spanners, torque wrenches, multimeters, battery testers, diagnostic scanners and manufacturer-specific service tools.
Useful credentials

items.text: DGT / NCVT-recognized Mechanic Two & Three Wheeler certificate.
EV safety and diagnostics training for relevant roles.

blocks.label: Countries to explore
blocks.text: Germany, Canada, Australia, UK and New Zealand.
Institutions / training providers to investigate

items.text: TAFE NSW — Australia; automotive vocational training.
German vocational training providers — automotive mechatronics pathways.
UK further-education colleges — motor vehicle maintenance and repair.

blocks.text: These are starting points for research, not confirmation that each currently offers a course specifically for two-wheelers. Check current program availability, entry criteria and qualification recognition.

blocks.label: Common requirements
blocks.text: Academic records, relevant trade experience where required, language proficiency, practical assessment and study documentation.

blocks.label: Potential roles
blocks.text: Motorcycle Technician, Motorcycle Mechanic, Small-Engine Technician and Automotive Service Technician.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Motorcycle dealerships, repair workshops, powersports, fleet service and EV service.
Two-wheeler-specific vacancies vary by market. Work authorization, licensing and sponsorship are not guaranteed.
